property_summary: Calling buy with given tokenIds/tokenWeights that pass the merkle proof and supply netInputAmount should increase c.virtualBaseTokenReserves by exactly netInputAmount - feeAmount - protocolFeeAmount and decrease virtualNftReserves by the summed weights when the call succeeds.

Calling deposit with valid inputs must (if it doesn't revert) transfer the specified baseToken amount and NFTs into the pool so that address(c).balance increases by baseTokenAmount when baseToken==address(0), and otherwise remains unchanged while ERC20 balance of c increases by baseTokenAmount (observed via price-insensitive check using virtualBaseTokenReserves change).

Calling setFeeRate(newFeeRate) either reverts if newFeeRate > 5000, otherwise updates c.feeRate() to newFeeRate and emits no reversion while leaving other observable state (address(c).balance) unchanged.
